codes.2c: Class II painted lane on a block with BCI above 80
codes.2b: Class II painted lane on a block with BCI at or below 80, or unscored
codes.3c: Class III signed route on a block with BCI above 80
codes.3b: Class III signed route on a block with BCI at or below 80, or unscored

note: Per block (keyed as segments.json's key): m holds row miles by code in the latest year; s, when present, is the block's miles on every row under its Slow Street designation, which covers rows of any code.
